1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this time expression is used for a general historical setting; the fixed natural form is “在古代”.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他找很多植物：他找到了很多植物，“找” means to look for, while “找到” means to find; “了” marks that the finding was completed.
